text_block_list.text:
One evening, as we're walking through
the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I wonder what all the fuss is about
over
there.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so they're holding a raffle. Looks
fun!

The coupon they're offering as a grand
prize is for
a well-known hot spring
that's notoriously hard to
book dates for.

It would be great if I could win it and
gift it to Fuji
Kiseki since she's been
working so hard...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to give it a try? I actually
have a
raffle ticket with me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here and everything, go
ahead and
give it a shot!

I almost take it, but I feel bad since she
got the
raffle ticket from her own
purchases. I push it
back to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you sure? I don't mind either way,
but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we do it together? We
can
combine our luck. What do you say?

At her suggestion, we grasp the
tumbler's lever
together and give it a
good spin!

A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: W-we got the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! I didn't expect to
actually win
the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Our combined luck must be really good.
Hehe.

I really want Fuji Kiseki to use the
coupon on
herself, so I hold it out to
her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You want me to have it? Are you
positive?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that you could use it to go
on
vacation and recharge.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Right. Okay. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well... Would you like to go with me,
then?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You told me to go with a good friend,
right? You
fit that category perfectly, so
let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean, only if you want to. I don't want
to force
you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good! Then it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That said, we're both so busy right now.
Let's
make plans for this once things
have settled
down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll put together the best itinerary for
you, so look
forward to it! ♪

So that's how I end up making a promise
with Fuji
Kiseki to go on vacation
together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wow, first prize! We did pretty great.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This hamburger steak sure is big,
though... Want
to split it with me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We can enjoy it while watching a nice
DVD
together. It'll be fun, I promise.

That night, Fuji Kiseki and I make a
wonderful
dinner out of the deluxe
carrot hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The cool thing about this play is how
lighthearted
the lines are despite being
a subliminal
commentary on the societal
problems of its time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of interpretations on the
meaning
of the protagonist's ribbon
colors, and...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Listen to me blabbing on. The
show's
about to start.

That night, I catch a rare glimpse of a
previously
unknown side to Fuji Kiseki as
she stares
captivated by what's on the
screen.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Second prize, huh? Not bad!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But... I don't know if we can finish all
these. It
might be tough with just the
two of us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea. We have nothing but
big
eaters in Ritto, so I'm sure they'll
love this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know! I should cook all these up before
serving
them to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you! I'd appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What should we make, then? Stew?
Steak? Oh,
cake might be good.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Cooking together is pretty fun.

With our combined efforts, we prepare a
lovely
carrot feast.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What a shame! But there's no need to be

disappointed just yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to cast some magic on this
carrot and
give you a good show. Can
you wait in your office
for about an hour,
please?

I do as she asks and wait for her in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for being so patient. All my
magic
preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Now, behold!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the carrot transformation of
the
century! In three, two, one!

Fuji Kiseki conjures up a fluffy plate of
carrot
omelet rice from thin air!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Did you like that? Eat up while it's
still
warm.

The carrot omelet rice she made is so
delicious I
can almost believe it really
was conjured by
magic.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Too bad... I guess we weren't so lucky
today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What a shame. I really wanted to see
your face
light up in joy...
We're both deflated by the result.
